# Test Flows & Coverage

Source of truth for **what must work** across web and mobile, plus honest
automation coverage. **Definitions** live in [`flows.yaml`](./flows.yaml);
this file is **generated**. Coverage is derived from Maestro `tags:` and
Playwright `@FLOW-…` tags (never hand-edited).

Manual session results (viewport pass/fail, WQA IDs, FIX links) live in

[`README.md`](./README.md). Interactive view: `pnpm flows:report`.

## Goals

Create automated tests for the flows below that cover:

- Functionality
- Accessibility

Have automated screenshot capture for web and mobile (iOS / Android) in
light and dark theme:

- **Web:** mobile / tablet / desktop viewports
- **Mobile:** phone and tablet sizes; screenshots per platform (iOS / Android)

## Legend

| Mark              | Meaning                                                            |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `FLOW-…`          | Stable hierarchical ID for this branch (E2E tags + `manual-qa.md`) |
| `[x]`             | Fully automated for that **exact** branch (spec/flow linked)       |
| `[ ]`             | Not fully automated — still required                               |
| `todo`            | Needs automation                                                   |
| `Partial`         | Thin coverage exists; not full for that platform                   |
| `manual` / `done` | Verified by hand (or fixed); not owned by E2E yet                  |

**Hierarchy:** headings nest areas → flows → branches; checklist indentation is
parent → **sub-cases**.

**Coverage:** derived automatically. Top-level `[x]` when the required platform(s)
for the area scope are covered. One Playwright/Maestro test may cover **many**
`FLOW-…` IDs (encouraged).

- **Playwright:** `tag: ['@FLOW-AUTH-LOGIN-SUCCESS']` on `test` / `test.describe`
- **Maestro:** `tags:` in YAML frontmatter include `FLOW-…` (plus `smoke` / `seeded`)

Edit definitions in [`flows.yaml`](./flows.yaml), then run `pnpm generate:flows-docs`.
